additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407297-DC/Si-D/AT - [YiiTie] Outlets out of order CRM:00796001376
additional_info.body:
Hi Kumar,
It seems that the Charger has come back online by itself. This is a very strange behavior. Well, Charger is online and I have updated it to FW 6.0. But now we have some error flags. The Charger has had this error behavior since commissioning. I also think that it sometimes switches itself off due to this error.
We got an info from R&D that the wiring has to be changed. I am therefore asking for a work order to be able to carry out the work according to R&D.
With best regards,
Daniel Kaiblinger
Siemens Aktiengesellschaft Österreich
RC-AT SI EA B EAST SM
Siemensstr.
90
1210 Vienna, Austria

additional_info.body:
Hello
Daniel Kaiblinger,
Greetings of the Day
I performed remote troubleshooting on the charger yesterday, and it came back online successfully. As per your previous email, you mentioned replacing the wire based on the R&D suggestion. I will assign this ticket to the RC-AT queue, where you can create / place the work order.
There were a few error flags active for the charger, but I have reconfigured the charger, and it is now available without any errors.
Thank you.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407297-DC/Si-D/AT - [YiiTie] Outlets out of order CRM:00796001376
additional_info.body:
Hi Kumar,
Thanks for the quick response.
Before you assign the ticket to us, I have a few more questions:
-I am not able to create a work order myself. Please create one for me. -> If the fault no longer occurs, we no longer need to carry out the wiring.
-How were you able to bring an offline charger online remotely?
-What configuration changes did you make so that the Charger no longer has error flags? I should carry out the rewiring as apparently the error can occur when the main switch closes. This should be fixed with FW 6.1. If this can be fixed with a config change, please let me know so that I can act more quickly the next time a fault occurs.
BR
Daniel

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407297-DC/Si-D/AT - [YiiTie] Outlets out of order CRM:00796001376
additional_info.body:
Hello
Daniel,
I don't have access to create the work order. You may monitor this charger if the fault reoccurs.
I am unable to bring the offline (SCB) charger online remotely. The charger was online in SCB, but the outlets were not available at that time.
The converter grouping was affected, which is why there were active error flags. I have saved the grouping again in the charger’s configuration at SCB, and the issue has been resolved.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
